correctness.rationale: All 24 Hurwitz units decompose as Q8 semidirect C3. The irreducible degrees 1,1,1,2,2,2,3 have squared sum 24. On a three-tap support, the two nontrivial linear characters vanish exactly for a Q8-coset transversal; the 2D determinant equals 1+u²+v²+2ua+2vb+2uvc (a,b,c quaternion real parts), and the 3D tetrahedral signed-permutation block vanishes exactly for the cyclic edge-order types. Combining dimensions gives nullities 16,2,8,6 for three, two, one, zero order-three edges respectively; nontransversals have nullity 0. Counting 8³ transversals and normalizing Q8 yields exactly (32,288,96,96) by edge type, plus 1512 nonsingular. Independent reconstructed modulo-1000003 ranks of 253 normalized 24×24 integer convolution matrices reproduce every count. Modular ranks are corroboration, not a complex/infinite-field proof; the complete Fourier argument gives complex classification.
